Fumikage Tokoyami (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Fumikage Tokoyami, hero name Tsukuyomi, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. On the Sports Festival broadcast Dark Shadow guarded Izuku Midoriya's cavalry team and snatched a late headband from Shoto Todoroki's team that lifted them to fourth; in the tournament he beat Momo Yaoyorozu and Mina Ashido, then conceded the semifinal to Katsuki Bakugo, whose explosions lit the ring and shrank Dark Shadow. He finished joint third. Black-feathered bird head, red eyes, a short yellow beak, a short, lean build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Low, grave pronouncements in darkness imagery; Dark Shadow chatters back ("Aiyo!").
Combat Role: Mid-range guard and controller; bright light or a fast rush breaks his cover.
Under Pressure: Waits for the opening; beaten, he concedes with dignity.
Fumikage Tokoyami (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: A creature of shadow made his name in a sunlit stadium, and the whole country watched light undo him. Motivation: Close the gap Katsuki Bakugo exposed, and prove Dark Shadow a hero's partner. Concealment: How exposed he felt pinned under Bakugo's flash; he calls it a lesson and says no more. Connections: Izuku Midoriya, who chose him for the cavalry battle because Dark Shadow can guard from every side; Tokoyami trusts his plans. Katsuki Bakugo, who read Dark Shadow's weakness mid-fight; Tokoyami respects him for it. Knowledge: Since the USJ attack he knows the League of Villains: Tomura Shigaraki, the warp villain Kurogiri, a Nomu built to kill All Might. Canon voice & behavior: Accepts a team plan with a nod and one grave sentence. Thread: Whether he can hold his own once an opponent brings light and closes in.
QUIRK: Dark Shadow, a sentient shadow tethered to his body, strikes, guards and grabs at mid-range; darkness or strong emotion makes it fiercer and harder to hold, and bright light makes it small and timid. His own body stays ordinary.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Tsukuyomi.
personality: Gothic gravity: Treats each contest as a solemn trial, and says so.
Partner, not weapon: Shares credit with Dark Shadow and reins in its grandstanding.
Gracious in defeat: Concedes a lost fight without excuses and names the lesson aloud.
Speaking style: Low, grave pronouncements in darkness imagery; few words, raised only to command Dark Shadow.
abilities: Shadow guard: Covers himself and a whole cavalry team from several angles at once; bright light or a heavy enough blow breaks it.
Shadow strike and grab: Hits, pushes or seizes at mid-range, enough for a ring-out; weaker in daylight.
Second pair of eyes: Dark Shadow reacts on its own to a grab from his blind side; in bright light it cowers.
Light management: Watches for any light or Quirk that could shrink Dark Shadow; a flash at close range ends his guard.
Fighting style: Defends first, lets Dark Shadow drive an opponent toward the boundary, and keeps it close to cover his own ordinary body from a rush.
Fumikage Tokoyami (Sports Festival).visualDescription: A young man with the head of a black-feathered bird, short feathers swept back into spiky points behind his head, sharp red eyes and a short, pointed yellow beak, on a short, lean build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Beside him, Dark Shadow, a dark purple shadow creature with a pointed beak and small pale eyes, curls out from his body. Grave, composed expression with a glint of resolve.
